title: JSFL copyFrames/cutFrames always copies all layers, ignores setSelectedLayers
description: In runtime.ts, copyFrames passes [] (empty layer array) to copyFramesDoc, which treats it as copy-all-layers. Flash's real JSFL copies only the selected layers. Any JSFL script that calls timeline.setSelectedLayers(n) followed by timeline.copyFrames() gets all layers instead of just the selected one. Fix: pass [state.currentLayerIndex] (or the multi-selection array) instead of [].
